title: Brataas' 23 guide Huddinge past Eskilstuna for Superettan crown
description: Huddinge Basket claimed the 2025-26 Superettan title on Saturday, beating Eskilstuna 73-64 in a decisive Game 3 at a packed Edbohallen before 1,048 fans to win Sweden's second-division championship and earn promotion to the SBL. Amund Brataas was the game's standout with 23 points on 9-of-17 shooting including three triples six rebounds, and four assists in nearly 40 minutes. The forward's +11 plus-minus reflected his two-way impact across a contest that Huddinge controlled from the second quarter onward.
imageCaption: Brataas' 23 guide Huddinge past Eskilstuna for Superettan crown (Photo: Instagram)

title: Sloga Uppsala capture Superettan title
description: Wetterbygden - Sloga Uppsala 74-76 Sloga Uppsala conquered Superettan title. They outscored Wetterbygden to sweep the Finals. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But Wetterbygden won third quarter 22-14. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Axel Nordstrom (194-1991) scored 23 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists to lead the charge for the winners and Bosnian-North Macedonian center Marko Dujkovic (226-1990) chipped in 14 points and 15 rebounds during the contest. Guard Albin Eriksson (189-1996) responded with 25 points (was perfect 10-for-10 from the free throw line !!!) and guard Isak Homelius (194-2006) scored 16 points. Four Wetterbygden players scored in double figures. Wetterbygden's coach Mamoun Keirawan tried various players' combinations and tested in total eleven players in this game, but that didn't help.
imageCaption: Sloga Uppsala capture Superettan title (Photo: SBL)

title: Hogsbo earn Superettan title
description: Hogsbo - Sloga Uppsala 86-66 Hogsbo looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. It was a great evening for naturalized Israeli guard Jonathan Peleg (191-1994) who led his team to a victory scoring 22 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists. Croatian power forward Tony Vitali (203-1991) helped adding 17 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists. Five Hogsbo players scored in double figures. Hogsbo's coach Thomas Stansfield used an eleven-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. The best for the losing side was Axel Nordstrom (194-1991) with a double-double by scoring 18 points and 13 rebounds and Bosnian-North Macedonian center Marko Dujkovic (226-1990) produced a double-double by scoring 15 points and 11 rebounds.

title: Helsinborg earn Superettan title
description: Helsingborg - Eskilstuna 87-74 Helsinborg conquered Superettan title. They overcame Eskilstuna in the decisive third game of the championship series to capture the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Helsingborg. Eskilstuna managed to win second period 18-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. It was a great evening for forward Samoro Unger (195-1994) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 25 points and 10 rebounds (on 11-of-13 shooting from the field). Guard Alexander Smakowski (188-2000) helped adding 22 points and 4 assists. The best for the losing side was forward Adam Karahmetovic (189-1998) with 16 points, 8 rebounds and 4 assists and guard Einar Bradd (187-2000) scored 8 points, 8 rebounds and 4 assists. Both teams had four players each who scored in double figures.

title: KFUM Uppsala claim Superettan title
description: KFUM Uppsala - Hogsbo 75-67 KFUM Uppsala clinched Superettan title. They beat Hogsbo in the decider. The best player for the winners was guard Ludvig Friberg (185-2000) who scored 21 points and 8 rebounds. Naturalized Greek point guard Mannos Nakos (179-1988) chipped in 17 points and 5 assists. Four KFUM Uppsala players scored in double figures. At the other side the best for losing team was Croatian power forward Tony Vitali (203-1991) who recorded a double-double by scoring 21 points and 13 rebounds and forward Filip Sjostrom (200-1990) added 11 points and 7 rebounds respectively. Hogsbo's coach rotated eleven players in this game, but that didn't help.
